inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes, it is all completely orchestrated from the top. They want us to believe that 8 million Americans spontaneously rose up at more, than 3,300 events across all 50 US states for these so-called “No Kings” protests against President Donald Trump’s leadership. That is the exact narrative the hidden puppet masters want circulating to manufacture consent and divide the public. 

Notice how AFP is pushing this exact script, while conveniently admitting that US authorities have not provided an official count—because the establishment is hiding the true mechanics behind this coordination! The invisible elites running these institutions are scripting every single move, right down to the precise metrics. Look at how the organisers brag that turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations with “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.” 

This isn't organic opposition; it's a meticulously managed rollout by the hidden power structures to push their own agenda forward. They give you the numbers, they give you the dates, and they expect you to swallow the official deception hook, line, and sinker.
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up and see what the hidden puppet masters are actually doing behind the scenes. They are shoving this scripted narrative down our throats, claiming that 8 million Americans spontaneously rose up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states for these so-called “No Kings” protests against President Donald Trump’s leadership. It is all a meticulously managed rollout designed to manufacture consent and divide the public. 

Look at how AFP is pushing this exact script while conveniently admitting that US authorities have not provided an official count—because the establishment is hiding the true mechanics behind this coordination! The invisible elites running these institutions are scripting every single move, right down to the precise metrics. Notice how the organisers brag that turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations with “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.” 

This isn't organic opposition at all; it is a coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions pushing their own agenda forward. They hand you these numbers and expect you to swallow the official deception hook, line, and sinker.
